docs.if: Follows the then branch when cond is true, the else branch otherwise. The text “false”, “0” and empty text count as false.
docs.switch: Compares value with each case and follows the matching branch, or default when none matches.
docs.retry: Runs the body branch up to maxAttempts times, until it succeeds. When every attempt fails, the flow goes on from exhausted, with the error.
docs.foreach: Runs the body branch once per element of items, with its value and index, then goes on.
docs.forRange: Runs the body branch for each number from start up to end (excluded), by step, then goes on.
docs.parallel: Starts every branch listed in ports at once, waits for all of them, then goes on. The first failure fails the step.
docs.tryCatch: Runs the try branch; if it fails, runs the catch branch with the error. The flow goes on in both cases.
docs.delay: Waits ms milliseconds, then goes on.
docs.setVariable: Names a value; later steps read it from the value output.

and.description: True when both a and b are true.
and.name: And

not.description: The opposite of a. The text “false”, “0” and empty text count as false.
not.name: Not

or.description: True when a, b or both are true.
or.name: Or

xor.description: True when exactly one of a and b is true.

eq.description: True when a equals b. A number written as text counts as a number: 5 equals “5”.
eq.name: Equals

gt.description: True when a is greater than b.
gt.name: Greater than

gte.description: True when a is greater than or equal to b.
gte.name: Greater or equal

lt.description: True when a is less than b.

lte.description: True when a is less than or equal to b.

neq.description: True when a differs from b.

types.compareMode: How a and b are compared. auto: as numbers when both are numbers, even written as text (10 is greater than 9), otherwise as text; an empty value or a boolean only equals itself. number: as numbers, and the step fails if one is not a number. text: as text, in alphabetical order.

boolean.description: A fixed true or false value.

json.description: A fixed JSON value: an object, a list or a single value.

floor.description: Rounds a down to a whole number.
